trigger: every resolver and validator test used a default-valued global policy, so unset-field inheritance from a customised global was never observed (7 mutants survived 13,855 assertions)
policy_floor: a FALSE-GREEN test offered as closure evidence for a blocking finding
classification_rationale: the earlier code-review closure evidence for a HIGH (override arms) could not observe the property it claimed
summary: False-green closure evidence for an earlier HIGH finding: policy floor. Fixed by a customised-global inheritance case (all 7 mutants KILLED) in d0b6766dc; the validator-base half was closed in 3ee1099ae.

trigger: an unvalidated or corrupt stored policy reaches compute_stability_score with negative, NaN, infinite or unordered edges: weights were withheld as invalid_weights but edges banded silently (e.g. {-5,-10,-20} banded a 12.0 app excellent)
classification_rationale: wrong band presented as correct with no signal; derived HIGH governs over the native SHOULD
summary: Scorer now withholds unusable edges as the new closed-vocabulary reason invalid_edges (after invalid_weights, before inconsistent); fixed in d0b6766dc with direct and precedence tests; the finer policy rules stay in the validator.

trigger: a consumer binds const auto& n = dex_tier_name(resolve_dex_score_policy(p, img).tiers, b), which returns a reference into a destroyed temporary (ASan stack-use-after-scope)
classification_rationale: borrowed reference into the argument; no site in the diff did it, fixed regardless of floor classification
summary: dex_tier_name rvalue overload deleted with a compile-time lock (d0b6766dc); the const-rvalue spelling found independently by two adversarial reviewers was closed in d0dda932c.

trigger: a caller omits the defaulted edges parameter (or pairs global edges with override weights): the tier name comes from the policy but the band from the default edges
classification_rationale: a required call-site argument can go missing silently
summary: dex_score_under_policy added as the one prescribed spelling (weights and edges from one effective policy), d0b6766dc.

trigger: 90 mutants were run against the real test file; 29 survived: global names[3] unchecked, resolver near-miss keys, non-adjacent duplicates, three fault-order pairs, boundary bytes 0x20/0x7E/0x1F, tolerance witnesses, fold-boundary keys
classification_rationale: bounded blast radius: a missing test is SHOULD, not a floor
summary: Added the missing rows; the surviving mutants were killed or recorded as equivalent in the mutation results.

trigger: a stored override key with NUL, control bytes, markup or megabytes (200 x 1 MiB validated in about 0.7 s) reaches the validator; non-ASCII uppercase keys were valid, making the UTF-8-widening claim false for keys
classification_rationale: the banner claim 'widening to UTF-8 never invalidates a stored document' was false for keys
summary: Keys restricted to printable ASCII, at most 260 bytes, byte-identical to ASCII lowercase (d0b6766dc); the claim is now true for names and keys.

trigger: a customer-authored name containing ', backslash, backtick or a leading = + - @ reaches a future sink that does not escape
classification_rationale: validator is a guard rail, not an escaper; consumers must escape per sink
summary: Consumer-rules banner states the validator is not an escaper (d0b6766dc).

trigger: a stored policy that was never re-validated on load (corruption, hand edit, later tightening) reaches the resolver
classification_rationale: reader-side duty (validate on load, fall back observably, count by fault token) was not stated
summary: Consumer-rules banner rewritten with the load-time duty, observable fallback, audit-verb and attribution duties (d0b6766dc).

trigger: a consumer renders profile 'default' as the shipped default while the global policy is customised
classification_rationale: the label means 'no per-application override applied'
summary: Banner defines the label; token kept (a maintainer-visible default, listed at the push gate).

trigger: five wording items: changelog reason list loose, 'consumer duties' vs rules, stability_band doc comment, reflow, rounding-mode claim
classification_rationale: wording capped at NICE
summary: Changelog and banner wording corrected (d0b6766dc).

trigger: a by-name Catch2 filter of a test case whose name contains a comma matches no test
classification_rationale: the comma is the filter OR separator
summary: Comma removed (d0b6766dc).

trigger: a displayed or exported score carries only profile 'default'/'override', not which policy or version produced it
classification_rationale: forward duty for the store/REST change
summary: Banner now requires the policy id/version beside any displayed or exported score, an audit verb, a securable and retention (d0b6766dc).

trigger: a stored policy whose edges pass stability_edges_valid but fail the validator ({99.99,99.98,99.97}, {1e-300,...}, {90,89.99,60}) reaches dex_score_under_policy with no dex_score_policy_fault call
classification_rationale: reporter derived HIGH: every sub-100 app reads poor under a corrupt stored policy
summary: Raised as derived HIGH by unhappy-path; security-guardian and architect did not file it.

adjudicated_by: Fable Architect agent (workflow wf_e1b492a8-05b), independent of the reporter (unhappy-path), the engineer and the orchestrator
adjudication_rationale: Derived I9/E4 verified mechanism with the trigger resting on absent code; layering ruled deliberate at governance round 1; documented MUST twice in the banner; the alternative fixes cost more than they protect.
trigger: a consumer that skips both documented MUSTs (validate on load; the resolver precondition) hands the scorer edges the validator would refuse; no consumer exists in this range
classification_rationale: every band returned is the correct band for the edges it was handed (unlike B2, where the edges had no coherent reading); the caller owns the policy and the validator
summary: Independent Architect adjudication: INFO. Rejected options: a self-check in dex_score_under_policy (loses the fault token and index the reader duty logs, would withhold a correct score under the false token invalid_edges for a display-name fault, reorders the withheld precedence) and tightening stability_edges_valid (duplicates tier_fault in the merged seam). The layering is pinned by a witness test (the scorer bands what the validator refuses) shown RED against a self-check mutant. Listed for the maintainer because the reporter's derivation was HIGH.

trigger: a process that calls fesetround to a non-default mode: edge_fault accepts 399-401 neighbouring doubles that round-to-nearest refuses, contradicting the banner sentence that another mode can only refuse
classification_rationale: a comment that contradicts the code
summary: Banner reworded: the validator is specified under round-to-nearest; another mode may accept or refuse different doubles (d0dda932c/697df6ce8).

trigger: 29 fresh mutants: the ASCII fold's Z end, a one-ulp edge off an exact decimal (relative tolerance), a 260-byte key never resolved, and the concept locks without a positive control survived
classification_rationale: bounded blast radius: a missing test is SHOULD, not a floor
summary: Four tests added and shown RED against their mutants; direct stability_edges_valid assertions and the override-then-global-edit row added (697df6ce8).

trigger: an agent-reported or customer-controlled image name over 260 bytes makes resolve_dex_score_policy lowercase the whole query (1 MiB: about 0.9 ms and a 1 MiB heap copy per call)
classification_rationale: no valid key can match a longer query, so the early Default return is unobservable for validated policies
summary: Default branch returned before lowercasing when the query exceeds the key cap (697df6ce8).

trigger: stale change narrative in two test comments, an ambiguous ranking sentence in the banner, a clumsy validation step, two changelog imprecisions (oversized weight vs total over 100; rank-flip takes weights only), one ragged reflow
classification_rationale: wording capped at NICE
summary: All five applied (697df6ce8).

trigger: a future consumer copies the rank-flip test (override weights as perturbed) or hand-rolls std::tolower for key canonicalisation (the fold lives in the detail namespace)
classification_rationale: test exemplar and banner disagreed on which weight set ranking uses
summary: Rank-flip test built from global-resolved policies; banner says fold A-Z only, no locale (697df6ce8).

trigger: the (0,100)/descending rules are written twice (tier_fault and stability_edges_valid); the closed-vocabulary banner does not say adding a token is permitted
classification_rationale: drift risk guarded by a fixed witness test
summary: Witness test that the validator accepts {99.9,0.2,0.1} and the scorer scores it, plus direct predicate assertions (697df6ce8); the vocabulary sentence deferred until the first consumer lands.

trigger: degraded fallback cannot be carried by the typed result; fault-order hiding; non-ASCII image names cannot be overridden
classification_rationale: all fail closed or are deliberate in this cut
summary: Documented in the banner as consumer-side duties; no code change.

trigger: names-before-weights order: a mutant that defers the names loop past the weight check survives all 14,132 assertions
classification_rationale: the Architect had rejected the same finding at code-review round 2 on the premise that a names-only move cannot be written without splitting tier_fault; two independent adversarial mutants refuted the premise
summary: Recorded as a false rejection; pinned by two cases in d0dda932c (mutant names_after_weights KILLED).
